  - Person (or household)

  - Your gift amount (what you spent on them)
  - Your share (for group gifts)
  - Balance (Their gift − Your gift)
  - Target match date / Window (e.g., 12 months)
  - Status (owed / matched / forgiven)
  - Notes (group split details, reciprocity agreement, non‑monetary value)
